title: Federated Learning of Binary Neural Networks: Enabling Low-Cost Inference
abstract: arXiv:2603.15507v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables distributed clients to jointly train a global model without sharing their raw data. However, deploying the resulting deep neural networks on resource-constrained edge devices remains challenging due to their inference-time computational and memory requirements. Binary Neural Networks (BNNs) offer substantial efficiency gains by representing weights and activations using a single bit, but achieving competitive accuracy under such aggressive quantization remains difficult. Rotation-aware binarization reduces quantization errors by aligning real-valued weights with their binary representations. Despite its effectiveness in centralized learning, applying rotation-aware binarization in FL is non-trivial due to discrepancies between local and global models, particularly under heterogeneous client data distributions. translated_title: 二值神经网络的联邦学习：实现低成本推理
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）使分布式客户端能够在不共享原始数据的情况下共同训练一个全局模型。然而，由于深度神经网络在推理时的计算和内存需求，将其部署在资源受限的边缘设备上仍然具有挑战性。二值神经网络（BNN）通过使用单个比特表示权重和激活值，可以带来显著的效率提升，但在如此激进的量化下实现有竞争力的准确率仍然十分困难。旋转感知二值化通过将实值权重与其二进制表示对齐来减少量化误差。尽管旋转感知二值化在集中式学习中非常有效，但由于本地模型与全局模型之间的差异，特别是在客户端数据分布异构的情况下，将其应用于联邦学习并非易事。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了FedBNN，一个联邦旋转感知二值化框架。
tldr: 提出FedBNN框架，首次将旋转感知二值化引入联邦学习，在客户端数据分布异构的条件下训练二值神经网络，实现边缘设备上的低成本高效推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FedBNN, a federated rotation-aware binarization framework that enables training binary neural networks under heterogeneous client data distributions for low-cost inference on resource-constrained edge devices.
